system.description: Aether concentrated in substrata can be directed as elemental force — the industrial application of a phenomenon that only now has a name. Learn Elementalist spells; use INS + WLP for offensive checks. Each SL unlocks one additional spell (earth and stone formulae prioritised; other elements from SL4 onward). Elemental spells come only via this skill — there is no ritual-discipline route.
